explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and 0 at most GO steps; it peaks at 10 at the GO step where the agent switches from a1 to a2 right after an unrewarded trial (usually after one or two misses in a row), mostly in the second half of the episode (trial 45 or later) and much weaker (about 4) earlier. On the next one or two GO steps it fades to about 7 and then about 3 whichever action is chosen, a1 GOs after a miss late in the episode sometimes show 1 to 3, and switching to a2 after a reward or staying on a2 after rewards gives 0.
